variants.row4_choice: The number row is matrix row 4 on one free GPIO per half; revI's pins are unchanged. Every free pin was routed on Flan46 (build_variant_pcb.py --row4, route_variant_keys.py): the lowest pin gives the shortest ROW4. Left: D15 188.09 mm, D18 190.60, D19 193.23, D20 195.73, D21 198.22 (15 vias each). Right: D6 178.58 mm, D5 180.41, D4 183.69, D3 185.52, D2 188.69 (13 vias each). On the left the number-row boards leave U1 GND3 unconnected on the PCB so ROW4 fits the RAW-side channel (tools/build_variant_pcb.py).
